svg.title: The factor-analysis model as a generative process
svg.desc: Three panels. Seven values of z drawn from a standard normal on a line; the same seven mapped by Lambda z + mu onto the line x2 = x1 / 2 in the plane; and then, around each mapped point, one contour of the axis-aligned noise Gaussian, taller than wide, with the observed x drawn as a cross near each. Only the crosses are observed.
svg.text: 3. x = Λz + μ + ε, Ψ = diag(1, 2)
one contour of 𝒩(0, Ψ) per point; × = x
